title: saemMicrobiome: SAEM Models for Longitudinal Microbiome Data
description: Implementation of zero-inflated beta regression (ZIBR) and zero-inflated beta-binomial mixed regression (ZIBBMR) models for longitudinal microbiome data, estimated with the SAEM (Stochastic Approximation EM) algorithm. R package with C++ (Rcpp) components.
